items.question: Is this element-purification considered to arise from union with imperishable Brahman?
premises: Element-purification is named as the result.
Its source is union with imperishable Brahman.
The statement is closed by iti.
items.inference: The verse presents element-purification as arising from union with imperishable Brahman.
uncertainties: The exact ritual referent of bhūta-śuddhi is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: This element-purification is considered to arise from union with imperishable Brahman.
